diffs.diff: angular_rate_dps: datasheet reading gives 0.06103515625 per count, the part's model has 0.0001831, 0.0001831, 0.0001831, 0.003906
diffs.evidence: BMI088 datasheet BST-BMI088-DS001, section 5.5.5 Register 0x0F GYRO_RANGE: '0x00 ±2000 16.384 LSB/°/s' (default value 0x00), so 1/16.384 = 0.06103515625 °/s per count. The model already uses exactly this: part.json sim.subDevices[0] (gyroscope, I2C 0x69) measures 0x02/0x04/0x06 have scale 0.06103515625, and the driver divides by 16.384 for the ±2000 range. The values the gate compared against (0.0001831 = 6/32768 g per count for accel at 0x12/0x14/0x16, default ±6 g; 0.003906 = 0.125/32 °C for the 11-bit temperature at 0x22) belong to the accelerometer device, not the gyroscope, so there is no actual disagreement.
